notes.title: Bug fix and balance patch
notes.notes:
[h1]Bugs addressed[/h1]
[list]
[*] Unity garbage collection - Unity was collecting a game object in use.
[*] Physics bug - characters were being pushed back from corner vertically (flying into air)
[*] Story mode - Game ending was being skipped too fast to see
[/list]
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fuzzy Ai has been rebalanced -  it should now be more likely to use the parry, this will be a work in progress, as balance is an ongoing process.
[*] Particle FX - the kick effect has now been changed to be in line with other attacks, red means a horizontal attack that can hit during a dodge. Blue means a vertical attack that cannot hit during a dodge.
[*] Also, extra particle fx have been added to specials to distinguish them visually
[/list]
